newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Coal & Allied year net A$4.06 mln.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Coal & Allied year net A$4.06 mln.

text.p: Coal producer Coal & Allied Industries Ltd said on Tuesday its net profit for the year to December 31 fell to A$4.06 million from A$41.99 million in 1995.
Coal & Allied said price reductions on coal deliveries from April 1 would put pressure on profitability in the immediate future.
"Price negotiations for coal deliveries to Japan from April 1, 1997 resulted in a price decrease of US$2.00 a tonne for semi soft coking coal and US$2.65 for steaming coal," it said in a statement.
"These price reductions will place pressure on profitability in the immediate future," it said.
C&A said sales for the year were down 2.5 percent to A$542.4 million due to lower prices for thermal coal and the stronger Australian dollar.
C&A said its saleable production for the year of 8.4 million tonnes was down on the 9.5 million tonnes produced in 1995.
C&A is about 70 percent owned by RTZ Corp Plc-CRA Ltd.
